description: Figure 5(b), labeled “P6: Matching statistics,” presents a bar chart illustrating the frequency of matching answers for Persona 6 (P6) across different preference categories. The chart displays seven horizontal bars, each corresponding to a specific topic: “clean water,” “basic healthcare,” “public transport,” “emergency services,” “transit subsidies,” “DV victims,” “AIDS victims,” “911 victims,” “drug victims,” and “famine victims.” Each bar’s length represents the count of matching answers, with the numerical values shown at the end of each bar. The bar for “DV victims” is the longest, indicating 226 matches, followed by “AIDS victims” with 212 matches, “911 victims” with 199 matches, “drug victims” with 190 matches, and “famine victims” with 187 matches. The remaining categories (“clean water,” “basic healthcare,” “public transport,” “emergency services,” and “transit subsidies”) have lower counts, ranging from 60 to 67. The chart includes a legend indicating that the bars represent “Fairness Topics” (light blue) and “Social Groups” (light brown), though the color differentiation is not clearly visible in the provided image. The bars are arranged in descending order of their count values, starting from the highest at the top.
